versions.changelog:
- Initial release of xiaohongshu-content-automation toolkit.
- Automates Xiaohongshu content creation: hot topic mining, copywriting with 3 templates, cover prompt generation, and data analysis.
- Provides ready-to-use commands for topic selection, copywriting, cover prompts, and note data analysis.
- Includes practical workflow instructions, headline formulas, and writing templates.
- Links to the full version (with all 4 modules) available for free on GitHub.
